# ORSPEX

> ORSPEX builds practical Windows software and free web tools for small business.
> Products include the Business Suite (offline ERP), the free PDF Compressor,
> the free Favicon Generator, and Orspex Jobs (a free job board).

## Products

- [ORSPEX Business Suite](https://orspex.netlify.app/#pricing): Offline ERP for small business. Accounting, inventory, manufacturing, sales, purchasing, and VAT. One-time purchase, $50.
- [ORSPEX PDF Compressor](https://orpexexitus-maker.github.io/orspex-pdf-compressor/): Free PDF compression tool. Runs online in your browser or offline with the Windows app.
- [ORSPEX Favicon Generator](https://orspex.netlify.app/favicon-generator/): Free favicon generator. Turn any image into favicon.ico, PNG variants, and a site.webmanifest. Runs in your browser — no uploads.
- [Orspex Jobs](https://orspex-jobs-seeking.vercel.app/): Free job board connecting job seekers with employers. No fees.

## About ORSPEX

ORSPEX builds practical, offline-first software for small businesses. Every tool is designed to be private, fast, and free of subscriptions. The Business Suite is the only paid product ($50 one-time); everything else is free forever.

- Website: https://orspex.netlify.app/
